storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry place; refrigerate in monsoon or after opening for longer life.
looksLike: Dry, white to cream, finely shredded or powdered coconut with a sweet, mild coconut smell and a slightly oily feel.
howToPick: Dry, white to cream and free-flowing, with a sweet coconut smell. Avoid a rancid or soapy smell, yellowing, damp clumps or sulphur-like smell.
shelfLife: About 6 months sealed (general guidance, not taken from a source in this run); the oil can turn rancid in warm, humid weather.
substitutes: Dry copra (sukha khobra) grated or ground

usedIn.raw: 5 g desiccated coconut per serving (about 1 tbsp, dry roasted for the dry garlic chutney)
